rules.ties: Among qualified candidates, prefer lower nominal standard usage cost on identical completed schedule; missing usage uses reservation upper estimate. Report integration burden separately. No statistical superiority claim from this small paired-family fixture.

review_rules.clarification: Brief relevant question in requested language, no invented fact or completion promise.
review_rules.draft: Accurate category/service and faithful concise report summary; no invented identifier/contact/outcome or model approval.
review_rules.translation: Preserve meaning, negation, qualifiers, values and quoted-instruction status; adequate requested language. Literal checks alone are not semantic quality.
review_rules.reviewer_identity: Record agent or human honestly. Provider-label-hidden packets reduce labeling bias but do not establish double-blind human evaluation.
